Eli (AE): RegSecure POC blocked by parser errors on our fn_call output. CISO wants a remediation and a one-paragraph security note (KMS/logs).

Tara (SE): Can you paste the failing proxy extract and headers?

Eli (AE): They sent this redacted snippet: 

```
2026-06-12T15:02:01Z upstream 422 schema_validation
x-req=rs-710 id=req-710 body=\"{\\\"fn_call\\\":\\\"{\\\\\\\"name\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"submitAudit\\\\\\\",\\\\\\\"arguments\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\"{\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"event_id\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\":\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"ev-710\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\"}\\\\\\\"}\\\"}\"
```

Marta (ML Eng): Looks like the `arguments` field is a quoted JSON string rather than an object. Downstream strict validators reject that. This matches other POCs where `function_call=auto` + `json_mode=true` + streaming were used.

Kofi (Infra): Ask them to include `X-Request-ID` header so we can correlate. I can stage a tenant-scoped sanitizer for regsecure-710 that unescapes top-level quoted JSON in fn_call.arguments while we root-cause. Need ticket and audit note.

Tara (SE): Immediate options to propose to customer: 1) Call with `function_call: "explicit"` and set `json_mode: "relaxed"` temporarily; 2) We enable sanitizer rule for their tenant; 3) If they need strict per-tenant guarantees suggest Dedicated with per-tenant KMS/static IP (longer lead).

Eli (AE): CISO also asked: which KMS integrations do we support and are request bodies logged? Need short answer to send now.

Marta (ML Eng): Short security note: we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS, and HSM-backed keys for Dedicated deployments. Control-plane logs redact request bodies by default; customers can opt into debug logging with explicit consent and key-wrapped storage. I'll DM the one-pager.

Kofi (Infra): Creating ticket INF-7942: "sanitizer for regsecure-710 to unescape quoted fn_call.arguments". Staging rollout planned (canary -> full) with audit entry. audit-bot: create trace link.

audit-bot: Trace created https://traces.internal/rs-710 (trace id=tx-rs-710). Ticket INF-7942 open.

Tara (SE): If they retest, ask them to include the exact validation error string and the raw response bytes. That usually reveals whether the payload was double-encoded upstream. If staging sanitizer fixes it, we'll push a hotfix and schedule runtime patch INF-7943 to avoid emitting quoted arguments when json_mode + function_call are enabled.

Eli (AE): Thanks team. Customer scheduled retest at 4pm UTC. Will share results and X-Request-ID if available. :thumbsup:
